18.02.2022

 

1. SOUTH CAUCASUS

 

: The Nagorno-Karabakh  National Assembly this morning adopted[1]  at second and final reading the package of bills  On the occupied territories of the Republic of Artsakh and related amendments . According to local reports, the law was adopted unanimously by a vote of 30 MPs . In addition, the National Assembly today also adopted the following statement of the National Assembly of the Republic of Artsakh on the occasion of Artsakh Revival Day : https://www.facebook.com/ArtsakhParliament/posts/338265718309865 (AM/RU). (&) Expressing the collective will and opinion of the people of Artsakh, the National Assembly of the Republic of Artsakh: reaffirms its commitment to the historic decision made on February 20, 1988, as well as the desire to defend their right to live freely in their native land; calls on interested international structures and, first of all, the Parliaments of the OSCE Minsk Group Co-Chair countries to pay attention to the fact that the Armenian people of Artsakh have struggled for centuries to preserve their identity, created material and cultural values, which are now under the threat of destruction as a result of the occupation of some territories of the Republic of Artsakh by Azerbaijan; calls on the Co-Chairs of the Minsk Group to take immediate steps to resume the negotiation process on the settlement of the Karabakh conflict in accordance with the mandate received from the OSCE. Lasting peace and stability in the region can only be achieved by respecting the fundamental rights and freedoms of the people of the Republic of Artsakh. It is for this purpose that the Armenians of Artsakh began their liberation struggle in 1988 and are ready to continue it with the determination to achieve this ultimate goal , it reads in particular. 

 

: A video[2] reportedly showing a convoy of Azerbaijani trucks blocked by the local population in Maghavuz / Chardagly ( Martakert province in Nagorno-Karabakh / Çardaql1 in Azerbaijan s Tartar district) was circulated yesterday on several social networks and media outlets. According to local reports, these trucks were transporting construction materials from Madaghis / Sugovushan to Kalbajar district under Russian Peacekeepers escort. According to comments[3] made yesterday evening by local MP  Metaxe Hakobyan ( Justice faction), the local population blocked the Azerbaijani convoy to protest against the recent incidents[4] during which a Nagorno-Karabakh soldier was wounded by Azerbaijani fire on February 15 and civilians were reportedly targeted by Azerbaijani fire in the village of Khramort. The trucks had to turn around and drive back , the Armenian news agencies reported. This is not the first time that the Karabakh people block roads to convoys from Azerbaijan. Until now, the issues have always been resolved on the ground and the vehicles were allowed to continue on their way. However, this time the patience of citizens has come to a breaking point. (&) The authorities either do not take steps or are powerless, so the residents are solving problems themselves. This is a kind of signal for everyone to hear and see what is happening in Karabakh , Metaxe Hakobyan was quoted as saying. The Azerbaijani side regularly violates the provisions of the tripartite statement. The local residents are wondering why Azerbaijanis can use the roads that are controlled by the Armenian side, while the way through Karvachar to the Republic of Armenia is closed to Karabakhis , she also said.

 

: According to the news agency Turan (quoting an informed source ), Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev is expected to pay a visit to Russia next week. Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev is expected to visit Moscow next week. (&) The visit will be a new milestone in the development of Azerbaijani-Russian relations, as well as in the strengthening of regional security , the news agency wrote[5] this morning (10:32AM, Baku time). 

 

: According to Azerbaijani news agencies[6], following his visits to Armenia and Georgia this week, EUSR T. Klaar will also visit Azerbaijan for regular high-level consultations next week . He is expected to have meetings with several Azerbaijani officials in Baku on February 21 , the news agencies reported. 

 

: The Armenian Foreign Ministry today confirmed[7] that Foreign Minister A. Mirzoyan will be participating in the 58thMunich Security Conference[8] on February 18-20. Minister Mirzoyan will have a number of meetings with his colleagues , the Armenian Foreign Ministry wrote. 

 

: According to local reports, two additional Azerbaijani civilians were today wounded by a mine explosion in Tartar district. According to a press release[9] published by the Tartar District Prosecutor's Office, two employees of the State Agency of Azerbaijan Automobile Roads (Alishah Safarov / Al1_ah SYfYrov, born in 1963 and Faig Safarov / Faiq SYfYrov, born in 1965) sustained various injuries as a result of a mine explosion while carrying out repair works in the village of Chayli (Çayl1) in Tartar district.

 

: Following his appointment as Armenia s Ambassador to the Russian Federation on January 5, former Defence Minister (1999-2000 and 2020-2021) Vagharshak Harutyunyan today presented copies of his credentials to Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Andrey Rudenko in Moscow. Topical issues on the bilateral and regional agendas were discussed during their conversation, which took place in a friendly atmosphere characteristic of the Russian-Armenian dialogue , the Russian Foreign Ministry reported[10] (12:37PM, Moscow time). 

 

: Several spectators present yesterday evening at Stade Vélodrome during the football match between Olympique de Marseille and Qaraba FK in the UEFA Europa Conference League displayed[11] dozens of flags of Armenia and Nagorno-Karabakh as well as banners with the inscriptions  Karabakh / Artsakh is Armenia  and  Azerbaijan, Land of Crimes . According to local reports[12], there were also some supporters of Qaraba FK with Azerbaijani and Turkish flags yesterday evening at Stade Vélodrome. The second encounter between Olympique de Marseille and Qaraba FK is scheduled for February 24 at the Tofiq Bahramov Republican Stadium in Baku[13]. 

 

: Georgia s Road Department this morning (10AM, Tbilisi time) published a press release[14] with photos showing ongoing construction of the Kvesheti-Kobi section[15] of the North-South Road Corridor. In particular, these photos show ongoing construction of a 9-km tunnel on the future bypass road of the Gudauri Kobi section often affected by avalanches on the Mtskheta-Stepantsminda-Lars highway. So far, 770 meters of the main tunnel have already been drilled.

 

: In addition to its daily information bulletin on activities of the Russian peacekeeping contingent in the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict zone (https://mil.ru/russian_peacekeeping_forces/bulletins/more.htm?id=12409586@egNews)   and its updated map of the situation in the area of the peacekeeping operation (https://mil.ru/files/morf/2022-02-18-NK-karta2800.jpg), the Russian Defence Ministry today (5AM, Moscow time) also published a separate press release[16] with a video[17] showing Russian peacekeepers ensuring safe entry of more than 600 vehicles and about 2,000 people into Nagorno-Karabakh, back and forth, in the past 24 hours . 

 

: Head of the Foreign Policy Department of the Azerbaijani Presidential Administration H. Hajiyev today met in Baku with a group of 30 members of the Nomad Mania[18] travel community who visited  all liberated territories over the past 72 hours. Very pleased to meet with Nomad Mania travellers and bloggers group who visited all liberated territories within 3 days of intense schedule. We talked about post conflict developments in the South Caucasus, Azerbaijan's agenda of peace and prospects of normalisation with Armenia , H. Hajiyev wrote[19] on Twitter. 

 

2. CRISIS IN GEORGIA

 

: According to local press reports[20], an initiative group today nominated former President (2001-2011) Eduard Kokoity as  presidential candidate for the election due to take place on April 10. Eduard Kokoity thanked his supporters in Tskhinvali and claimed that today the situation in the Republic is more complicated than even before the 2008 war . He called for consolidation of active forces, prevention of migration of young people and creation of conditions for the return of citizens to the republic . Sputnik Ossetia recalled that Kokoity also tried to run for the presidency in the 2017 elections, but the Central Election Commission did not register him due to his failure to comply with residency requirements .

 

: The South Ossetian  authorities today (9AM, local time) indicated[21] that they registered 25 additional COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours (for a total of 142 tests). According to local reports, a total of 13,789 COVID-19 cases have been registered in the entity since May 2020 (12,725 people already recovered, while at least 211 have died[22] from COVID-19 in the entity since the beginning of the pandemic, including a 54-year-old woman and a 63-year-old man in the past 24 hours). 1,064 individuals are currently under quarantine in South Ossetia. 66,276 tests have been performed in the entity so far. 

 

Yesterday evening (11:41PM, local time), the Abkhaz  authorities indicated[23] that they had registered 305 additional COVID-19 cases in the previous 24 hours (for a total of 538 tests). The total number of infected persons in Abkhazia now stands at 50,186. A total of 41,706 patients already recovered, while 633 people have died (+5 in the past 24 hours / men aged 55, 72, 84, 84 and 87).

P R E S S   A N D   M E D I A   R E V I E W

 

18.02.2022

 

1. SOUTH CAUCASUS

 

: The Nagorno-Karabakh  National Assembly this morning adopted[1]  at second and final reading the package of bills  On the occupied territories of the Republic of Artsakh and related amendments . According to local reports, the law was adopted unanimously by a vote of 30 MPs . In addition, the National Assembly today also adopted the following statement of the National Assembly of the Republic of Artsakh on the occasion of Artsakh Revival Day : https://www.facebook.com/ArtsakhParliament/posts/338265718309865 (AM/RU). (&) Expressing the collective will and opinion of the people of Artsakh, the National Assembly of the Republic of Artsakh: reaffirms its commitment to the historic decision made on February 20, 1988, as well as the desire to defend their right to live freely in their native land; calls on interested international structures and, first of all, the Parliaments of the OSCE Minsk Group Co-Chair countries to pay attention to the fact that the Armenian people of Artsakh have struggled for centuries to preserve their identity, created material and cultural values, which are now under the threat of destruction as a result of the occupation of some territories of the Republic of Artsakh by Azerbaijan; calls on the Co-Chairs of the Minsk Group to take immediate steps to resume the negotiation process on the settlement of the Karabakh conflict in accordance with the mandate received from the OSCE. Lasting peace and stability in the region can only be achieved by respecting the fundamental rights and freedoms of the people of the Republic of Artsakh. It is for this purpose that the Armenians of Artsakh began their liberation struggle in 1988 and are ready to continue it with the determination to achieve this ultimate goal , it reads in particular. 

 

: A video[2] reportedly showing a convoy of Azerbaijani trucks blocked by the local population in Maghavuz / Chardagly ( Martakert province in Nagorno-Karabakh / Çardaql1 in Azerbaijan s Tartar district) was circulated yesterday on several social networks and media outlets. According to local reports, these trucks were transporting construction materials from Madaghis / Sugovushan to Kalbajar district under Russian Peacekeepers escort. According to comments[3] made yesterday evening by local MP  Metaxe Hakobyan ( Justice faction), the local population blocked the Azerbaijani convoy to protest against the recent incidents[4] during which a Nagorno-Karabakh soldier was wounded by Azerbaijani fire on February 15 and civilians were reportedly targeted by Azerbaijani fire in the village of Khramort. The trucks had to turn around and drive back , the Armenian news agencies reported. This is not the first time that the Karabakh people block roads to convoys from Azerbaijan. Until now, the issues have always been resolved on the ground and the vehicles were allowed to continue on their way. However, this time the patience of citizens has come to a breaking point. (&) The authorities either do not take steps or are powerless, so the residents are solving problems themselves. This is a kind of signal for everyone to hear and see what is happening in Karabakh , Metaxe Hakobyan was quoted as saying. The Azerbaijani side regularly violates the provisions of the tripartite statement. The local residents are wondering why Azerbaijanis can use the roads that are controlled by the Armenian side, while the way through Karvachar to the Republic of Armenia is closed to Karabakhis , she also said.

 

: According to the news agency Turan (quoting an informed source ), Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev is expected to pay a visit to Russia next week. Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev is expected to visit Moscow next week. (&) The visit will be a new milestone in the development of Azerbaijani-Russian relations, as well as in the strengthening of regional security , the news agency wrote[5] this morning (10:32AM, Baku time). 

 

: According to Azerbaijani news agencies[6], following his visits to Armenia and Georgia this week, EUSR T. Klaar will also visit Azerbaijan for regular high-level consultations next week . He is expected to have meetings with several Azerbaijani officials in Baku on February 21 , the news agencies reported. 

 

: The Armenian Foreign Ministry today confirmed[7] that Foreign Minister A. Mirzoyan will be participating in the 58thMunich Security Conference[8] on February 18-20. Minister Mirzoyan will have a number of meetings with his colleagues , the Armenian Foreign Ministry wrote. 

 

: According to local reports, two additional Azerbaijani civilians were today wounded by a mine explosion in Tartar district. According to a press release[9] published by the Tartar District Prosecutor's Office, two employees of the State Agency of Azerbaijan Automobile Roads (Alishah Safarov / Al1_ah SYfYrov, born in 1963 and Faig Safarov / Faiq SYfYrov, born in 1965) sustained various injuries as a result of a mine explosion while carrying out repair works in the village of Chayli (Çayl1) in Tartar district.

 

: Following his appointment as Armenia s Ambassador to the Russian Federation on January 5, former Defence Minister (1999-2000 and 2020-2021) Vagharshak Harutyunyan today presented copies of his credentials to Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Andrey Rudenko in Moscow. Topical issues on the bilateral and regional agendas were discussed during their conversation, which took place in a friendly atmosphere characteristic of the Russian-Armenian dialogue , the Russian Foreign Ministry reported[10] (12:37PM, Moscow time). 

 

: Several spectators present yesterday evening at Stade Vélodrome during the football match between Olympique de Marseille and Qaraba FK in the UEFA Europa Conference League displayed[11] dozens of flags of Armenia and Nagorno-Karabakh as well as banners with the inscriptions  Karabakh / Artsakh is Armenia  and  Azerbaijan, Land of Crimes . According to local reports[12], there were also some supporters of Qaraba FK with Azerbaijani and Turkish flags yesterday evening at Stade Vélodrome. The second encounter between Olympique de Marseille and Qaraba FK is scheduled for February 24 at the Tofiq Bahramov Republican Stadium in Baku[13]. 

 

: Georgia s Road Department this morning (10AM, Tbilisi time) published a press release[14] with photos showing ongoing construction of the Kvesheti-Kobi section[15] of the North-South Road Corridor. In particular, these photos show ongoing construction of a 9-km tunnel on the future bypass road of the Gudauri Kobi section often affected by avalanches on the Mtskheta-Stepantsminda-Lars highway. So far, 770 meters of the main tunnel have already been drilled.

 

: In addition to its daily information bulletin on activities of the Russian peacekeeping contingent in the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict zone (https://mil.ru/russian_peacekeeping_forces/bulletins/more.htm?id=12409586@egNews)   and its updated map of the situation in the area of the peacekeeping operation (https://mil.ru/files/morf/2022-02-18-NK-karta2800.jpg), the Russian Defence Ministry today (5AM, Moscow time) also published a separate press release[16] with a video[17] showing Russian peacekeepers ensuring safe entry of more than 600 vehicles and about 2,000 people into Nagorno-Karabakh, back and forth, in the past 24 hours . 

 

: Head of the Foreign Policy Department of the Azerbaijani Presidential Administration H. Hajiyev today met in Baku with a group of 30 members of the Nomad Mania[18] travel community who visited  all liberated territories over the past 72 hours. Very pleased to meet with Nomad Mania travellers and bloggers group who visited all liberated territories within 3 days of intense schedule. We talked about post conflict developments in the South Caucasus, Azerbaijan's agenda of peace and prospects of normalisation with Armenia , H. Hajiyev wrote[19] on Twitter. 

 

2. CRISIS IN GEORGIA

 

: According to local press reports[20], an initiative group today nominated former President (2001-2011) Eduard Kokoity as  presidential candidate for the election due to take place on April 10. Eduard Kokoity thanked his supporters in Tskhinvali and claimed that today the situation in the Republic is more complicated than even before the 2008 war . He called for consolidation of active forces, prevention of migration of young people and creation of conditions for the return of citizens to the republic . Sputnik Ossetia recalled that Kokoity also tried to run for the presidency in the 2017 elections, but the Central Election Commission did not register him due to his failure to comply with residency requirements .

 

: The South Ossetian  authorities today (9AM, local time) indicated[21] that they registered 25 additional COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours (for a total of 142 tests). According to local reports, a total of 13,789 COVID-19 cases have been registered in the entity since May 2020 (12,725 people already recovered, while at least 211 have died[22] from COVID-19 in the entity since the beginning of the pandemic, including a 54-year-old woman and a 63-year-old man in the past 24 hours). 1,064 individuals are currently under quarantine in South Ossetia. 66,276 tests have been performed in the entity so far. 

 

Yesterday evening (11:41PM, local time), the Abkhaz  authorities indicated[23] that they had registered 305 additional COVID-19 cases in the previous 24 hours (for a total of 538 tests). The total number of infected persons in Abkhazia now stands at 50,186. A total of 41,706 patients already recovered, while 633 people have died (+5 in the past 24 hours / men aged 55, 72, 84, 84 and 87).
